```text
Starts website HTTP server

Usage:
  ytt website [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help[=true|false]                help for website
      --listen-addr string               Listen address (default "localhost:8080")
      --redirect-to-https[=true|false]   Redirect to HTTPs address (default true)
```
